sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics

As you progress through the levels, the targets become increasingly difficult to hit and the number of arrows available becomes increasingly limited.

One of the key features of Arrow Shoot is its use of physics-based gameplay. The arrows you shoot will bounce off surfaces and interact with objects in the environment, making it even more challenging to hit your targets.
